item.text: The failure is a 10× currency-conversion error: the shared API helper divides stored cents by 10, while the cart needs cents-to-CLP conversion by 100. That helper is outside my frontend write scope, so I’ll keep the correction local to the cart and flag the API ownership issue in the handoff.
